items.title: Introducing AI Futures
items.content: Introducing AI Futures, a new OpenAI blog exploring how transformative AI could reshape power, governance, the economy, and individual freedom.
items.contentSnippet: Introducing AI Futures, a new OpenAI blog exploring how transformative AI could reshape power, governance, the economy, and individual freedom.

summaries.zh: OpenAI推出了全新博客专栏“AI Futures”，旨在探讨变革性人工智能可能如何重塑权力格局、治理体系、经济形态以及个人自由。该专栏将聚焦于AI技术带来的深远社会影响，为读者提供关于未来发展趋势的深度思考与分析。
summaries.en: OpenAI has launched a new blog called **AI Futures**, dedicated to exploring how transformative artificial intelligence could reshape key aspects of society. The blog will examine potential impacts on power structures, governance, the economy, and individual freedom. It serves as a platform for discussing the broader societal implications of advanced AI.

items.title: Stampli cuts launch hours by 68% using ChatGPT Work
items.content: With a fixed deadline and design resources committed elsewhere, Stampli used Codex and ChatGPT Work to compress weeks of launch production into days.
items.contentSnippet: With a fixed deadline and design resources committed elsewhere, Stampli used Codex and ChatGPT Work to compress weeks of launch production into days.

summaries.zh: Stampli 在面临固定截止日期且设计资源已被占用的情况下，借助 Codex 和 ChatGPT Work，将原本需要数周的发布筹备工作压缩至数天完成。此举显著加快了从创意到产品上市的进程，展示了 AI 工具在提升项目效率、缩短交付周期方面的实际价值。文章重点突出了 AI 辅助工具如何帮助团队突破资源限制，快速实现目标。
summaries.en: Stampli leveraged ChatGPT Work and Codex to accelerate product launches under a tight deadline. With design resources already assigned elsewhere, the team used these AI tools to compress what would typically take weeks of launch production into just days. This enabled faster movement from idea to market while working around limited internal capacity. The case highlights how AI-assisted workflows can streamline production processes and help teams meet fixed timelines efficiently.

items.title: Offering Zero Data Retention for frontier models
items.content: OpenAI reaffirms Zero Data Retention for eligible API customers and previews Private Safety Processing for advanced AI safety without compromising data privacy.
items.contentSnippet: OpenAI reaffirms Zero Data Retention for eligible API customers and previews Private Safety Processing for advanced AI safety without compromising data privacy.

summaries.zh: OpenAI重申，符合条件的API客户仍可享受零数据保留（ZDR）政策，并预览了“私人安全处理”功能。该功能旨在为前沿模型提供高级AI安全保护，同时不损害数据隐私。这意味着客户数据用于安全审查时不会被存储，兼顾了安全需求与隐私保障。
summaries.en: OpenAI has reaffirmed its commitment to Zero Data Retention (ZDR) for eligible API customers using frontier models. The company also previewed a new capability called Private Safety Processing, designed to enable advanced AI safety measures without compromising data privacy. This initiative underscores OpenAI’s efforts to maintain strict data-handling standards while advancing safety protocols. The announcement highlights both the continuation of existing privacy protections and the introduction of new methods to balance robust safety with user confidentiality.

items.title: Replit expands access to software creation with GPT-5.6 Luna
items.content: Replit introduces Free Mode, powered by GPT-5.6 Luna, so anyone can turn ideas into working software without worrying about token costs.
items.contentSnippet: Replit introduces Free Mode, powered by GPT-5.6 Luna, so anyone can turn ideas into working software without worrying about token costs.

summaries.zh: Replit推出全新免费模式（Free Mode），由GPT-5.6 Luna驱动，让任何人都能将自己的想法转化为可运行的软件，无需担心令牌（token）费用。这一举措降低了软件开发的门槛，使用户无需付费即可体验AI辅助编程。总结来说，Replit旨在通过免费模式普及软件创建能力，以GPT-5.6 Luna为技术核心，让创意实现更简单、更便捷。
summaries.en: Replit has expanded access to software creation by introducing Free Mode, powered by GPT-5.6 Luna. This new offering allows anyone to turn ideas into working software without worrying about token costs. The feature lowers barriers for users, making it easier to build and experiment with software directly on the platform.

items.title: Strengthening democratic oversight in national security
items.content: OpenAI launches an initiative to strengthen democratic oversight of AI in national security, supporting government institutions with tools, training, and expertise.
items.contentSnippet: OpenAI launches an initiative to strengthen democratic oversight of AI in national security, supporting government institutions with tools, training, and expertise.

summaries.zh: OpenAI启动一项新举措，旨在加强对国家安全领域人工智能应用的民主监督。该计划将为政府机构提供工具、培训及专业知识支持，帮助其提升对AI技术的监管与治理能力，确保国家安全相关AI系统在民主框架下得到有效 oversight。
summaries.en: OpenAI has launched a new initiative aimed at strengthening democratic oversight of artificial intelligence in the national security sector. The program provides government institutions with tools, training, and expert support to help ensure responsible and transparent use of AI in security contexts. This effort focuses on reinforcing democratic accountability while addressing the growing role of AI in national security operations.

items.title: Partnering with CodeAI to prepare the first AI generation
items.content: OpenAI and CodeAI are partnering to help students build AI literacy, think critically about AI, and develop the skills to use and shape it responsibly.
items.contentSnippet: OpenAI and CodeAI are partnering to help students build AI literacy, think critically about AI, and develop the skills to use and shape it responsibly.

summaries.zh: OpenAI与CodeAI宣布合作，旨在帮助学生建立AI素养，培养对AI的批判性思维，并掌握负责任地使用和塑造AI的技能。此次合作聚焦于为“第一代AI世代”做好准备，强调教育在AI时代的重要性。通过双方携手，学生将获得更全面的AI认知与实践能力。
summaries.en: OpenAI has announced a partnership with CodeAI aimed at preparing students to become the first AI-literate generation. The collaboration focuses on helping students build a strong foundation in AI literacy, encouraging critical thinking about AI technologies, and equipping them with the skills to use and shape AI responsibly. This initiative underscores a shared commitment to education and the responsible development of AI capabilities among young learners.

items.title: Pacing model development in an era of cyber-critical capabilities
items.content: OpenAI is strengthening monitoring, alignment, and security for frontier AI models. See how new safeguards are guiding the pace of model development.
items.contentSnippet: OpenAI is strengthening monitoring, alignment, and security for frontier AI models. See how new safeguards are guiding the pace of model development.

summaries.zh: OpenAI正在加强对前沿AI模型的监控、对齐与安全措施。文章指出，在网络安全关键能力日益重要的时代，新的安全保障机制正在引导模型开发的节奏。这意味着OpenAI在推进模型能力的同时，更加注重通过安全评估和防护措施来把控发展速度，确保前沿模型的研发与部署更加稳健可控。
summaries.en: OpenAI is introducing stronger safeguards for its frontier AI models, focusing on enhanced monitoring, alignment, and security. These new measures are designed to guide the pace of model development amid growing concerns over cyber-critical capabilities. By integrating these protections, OpenAI aims to balance innovation with responsible deployment, ensuring advanced systems remain safe and aligned. The approach reflects a broader effort to manage risks associated with highly capable AI while continuing technical progress.

items.title: What building an AI-native finance function taught me
items.content: OpenAI CFO Sarah Friar shares five lessons for building an AI-native finance function, from automated forecasting to stronger controls and AI ROI.
items.contentSnippet: OpenAI CFO Sarah Friar shares five lessons for building an AI-native finance function, from automated forecasting to stronger controls and AI ROI.

summaries.zh: OpenAI首席财务官Sarah Friar分享了打造AI原生财务职能的五个经验，涵盖自动化预测、强化内控及AI投资回报率等关键方面。她结合自身实践，阐述了将AI融入财务工作带来的效率提升与管理变革。文章强调，AI不仅助力财务预测与风险控制，还需关注其实际ROI，以实现可持续的数字化转型。
summaries.en: OpenAI CFO Sarah Friar shares practical lessons from building an AI-native finance function. The article outlines five key takeaways, focusing on areas such as automated forecasting, which improves efficiency and accuracy, stronger internal controls, and how to evaluate AI return on investment. Friar's insights offer guidance on integrating AI into finance operations, emphasizing both the benefits and the importance of robust governance. The piece provides a leadership perspective on transforming financial processes through AI adoption and measuring the value of those investments.
